heading.title: Of Contracts, Voidable Contracts and Void Agreements

article.title: “Consent” defined.
article.content:
13“Consent” defined.

Section 13  ·  Chapter II  ·  page 13 of the Act
Two or more persons are said to consent when they agree upon the same thing in the same sense.
